cmd.help: Show help for a command. With --json: the command tree, arguments and exit codes
cmd.events: Follow daemon events in real time (with --json, one JSON per line). Stop with Ctrl+C
cmd.install: Install Saba-chan on this PC without the window installer
cmd.uninstall: Remove Saba-chan from this PC (settings and servers are kept unless removed)

Names can be partial (e.g. start pal). Running with no arguments in a terminal opens the full-screen menu (SABA_NO_TUI=1: interactive shell).
In scripts, use --json and --yes. Exit codes: 0 success · 1 failure · 2 usage · 3 daemon connection failed · 4 not found · 130 canceled

tui.help:
Tab / Shift+Tab  next / previous area (pages → list → detail tabs → buttons → content)
←→↑↓  move in the direction shown,  Esc  always one step back
1-5  jump to a page,  Ctrl+K  find anything (screens, settings, commands)
s  start/stop the selected server,  r  restart,  n  new server
Settings tab  ←→ change value · Space toggle · Enter type · / find · Ctrl+S save · Esc revert
Server console  typing suggests game commands (Tab fills), Enter sends, ↑↓ previous input
:  command line (exactly what follows saba-chan-cli, Tab completes). Buttons and saves run the same commands
F2  open/close output,  PgUp/PgDn, mouse wheel  scroll,  F9  switch to GUI
Ctrl+C  stop the running command,  q  quit (the daemon and servers keep running)
